root: ^Hello everyone!! I am so pleased to see all of you here! Now please, make yourself at home!
^The spotlight turns off and Richard begins to make his way to all of the various people, laughing and joking along the way.
^After a bit of time, he finally makes his way to you.
^Holy jeez man… you actually made it! Bring it in man!
^Richard hugs you very tightly, almost a bit suffocatingly so.
^Riche! Oh my god man, how has it been? How… how the hell do you have all of this?

^Oh come on man, this night isn’t about me, it’s about all the people in my life. Tell me, how’s the detective business going? Last I heard from you, you had just gotten started. What are you working on?
^Well… man it has been a while huh? Well I’m now a senior detective, and lately… I’ve been working on a large-scale burglary… an ongoing financial fraud case… and even a few homicide cases!
^Wow… very interesting stuff. Anyways, gotta bounce! I’ve got a lot of people to see.

^Just like that, he was gone. Richard was off talking to more of the people at the party as if he hadn’t even known you. For the rest of the evening, you stand awkwardly by the large dining table, occasionally grabbing a small bite to eat. After a few hours, the butler comes back.
